description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the PsrHttpFactoryHelper class, testing its methods for creating PSR-7 requests and responses from the project's Request and Response classes, and vice versa. It includes tests for handling different request types, headers, and binary responses within the OAuth service context.

classes.name: PsrHttpFactoryHelperTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for PsrHttpFactoryHelper, testing request and response conversions in the OAuth service context.

methods.name: testCreatePsr7Request
methods.description: Tests creation of PSR-7 requests from project HTTP Request objects, including GET and POST with headers and body.

methods.name: testCreatePsr7Response
methods.description: Tests creation of PSR-7 responses from project HTTP Response objects, including standard responses and binary file responses.

methods.name: testCreateRequestFromPsr7Request
methods.description: Tests creation of project Request object from a PSR-7 request, verifying method, URI, query parameters, and attributes.

methods.name: testCreateResponseFromPsr7Response
methods.description: Tests creation of project Response object from a PSR-7 response, verifying status code and headers.
